title: Risky Business (1920 film)

based_on: screen story by Douglas Doty and John Colton

text.lead: Risky Business is a 1920 American silent drama film directed by Harry B. Harris and Rollin S. Sturgeon released by Universal. It stars Gladys Walton.
text.cast:
- Gladys Walton as Phillipa
- Lillian Lawrence as Mrs. Fanshaw Renwick
- Maude Wayne as Errica
- Nanine Wright as Grandma
- Grant McKay as Roger
- Fred Malatesta as Ralli
- John Gough as Valet
- Louis Willoughby as Captain Chantry
- Fred Andrews as Dr. Houghton
